description: An oil-style painting of a bearded man in a dark turban and black layered robes sits at right, writing with a stylus on a wooden tablet. Behind him on a grey, misty riverbank, fur-clad men with axes and a tattooed warrior stand by a longship, barrels and a fire. A sword and axe lie in the foreground at bottom left. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
